capabilities: Create side-by-side Markdown blocks using horizontal/hblock code blocks and --- separators
Resize columns with a draggable divider and per-block width controls
Embed pages and sections inside blocks with live editing
Auto-scale images within blocks and persist block widths
Customize dividers, backgrounds, borders, spacing, and colors through a styling settings tab
disambiguation: Not a general CSS theming tool; it creates column layouts from special code blocks in notes.
extras: Styling is applied via CSS variables so themes and snippets can override it; the styling tab lives under Settings → Community Plugins → Horizontal Blocks – Styling. README shows code examples but the preview headings are empty.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to lay note content in multiple resizable columns within a single note.

relations.evidence: Bring Notion-style layouts with blocks side-by-side

summary: Adds Notion-style side-by-side Markdown blocks via code blocks, with resizable columns, embeds, images, internal links, and styling settings.
